name: econ-finance-lit-review
description: Comprehensive, systematic, link-verified literature reviews for any economics or finance research question: question-first intake, a default five-year window, search across Web of Science, Scopus, ScienceDirect, Google Scholar, Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv, Consensus and Elicit, three-pass study cards with weaknesses in the chat, and an illustrated DOCX/PDF report.
